ouverture-portail-numerique.title: Terra Nova’s digital portal opens its services
ouverture-portail-numerique.excerpt: Create your account, find city services and reach the administration: everything is now in one place.
ouverture-portail-numerique.body:
The digital portal of the City of Terra Nova is open. Residents can create their account, sign in to their personal space and access the main municipal services.

New services will be added over time: request tracking, city announcements and online procedures.

For any question, the Citizen Relations department remains reachable through the portal’s contact form.

collecte-encombrants.title: Bulky item collection: new monthly round
collecte-encombrants.excerpt: Bulky item collection now takes place on the first Saturday of every month in all neighbourhoods.
collecte-encombrants.body:
To make life easier for residents, bulky item collection will now be held on the first Saturday of every month.

Items must be left outside the home the evening before, following the sorting instructions.

Hazardous waste (paint, chemicals) is not accepted and must be taken to a recycling centre.

travaux-avenue-des-fondateurs.title: Roadworks on avenue des Fondateurs
travaux-avenue-des-fondateurs.excerpt: Road resurfacing work is planned on avenue des Fondateurs for three weeks.
travaux-avenue-des-fondateurs.body:
The City is resurfacing the roadway of avenue des Fondateurs. The work will last about three weeks.

Alternating traffic will be in place during peak hours. Public transport lines are adjusting their routes.

The City thanks residents for their understanding and is doing its best to limit the disruption.

permanences-etat-civil.title: Civil registry office hours on Saturday morning
permanences-etat-civil.excerpt: The civil registry service now holds office hours on Saturday morning by appointment.
permanences-etat-civil.body:
To better support residents, the civil registry service now offers office hours on Saturday morning.

Appointments can be booked from the personal space or through the portal’s contact form.

Urgent matters are still handled as a priority on weekdays.
